system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Please read the following HTML code, and then return an Xpath that can recognize the element in the HTML matching the instruction below.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are Python format strings with {0},{1} slots filled per task; role_prompt is a fixed string. Line number approximate from the displayed excerpt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Top-down refers to starting from the root node of the current DOM tree, progressively refining down to the specific node containing the target informa-tion.
env_context_strategy.note: Full preprocessed HTML is injected into the prompt, and the model then prunes it with XPath steps (top-down/step-back). The closest value is mixed: the page is injected and navigation is agent-driven.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: all XPath expres-sions except the last one are used for pruning the web page
context_compaction.note: The HTML is pruned to a sub-tree; the paper also strips script/style tags and attributes (Sec. 3.2).

observation_format.note: HTML source and extracted results are presented as text. Line number approximate.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Please output in the following Json format:
tool_call_format.note: The model emits JSON containing an xpath or an action. Line number approximate.

tool_count.note: No tool schema is visible. The actions are XPath expressions, and the crawler module that implements them (reflexion_crawler.py, stepback_crawler.py) is not included in the evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: the task objective is to generate an executable rule/action sequenceA to extract target information o from all webpages.

loop_primitives.note: Progressive generation runs XPath, judges the result and retries up to d_max=5; synthesis selects among the candidates from the n_s seed pages.
